hero.title: The World of Loulou & Lou
hero.subtitle: Screen-free listening time: songs, fairytales and calming musical meditations, made with a real live band. One cosy corner of the internet for everything Loulou & Lou.

home.worldSubtitle: We've made music, stories and characters for years, scattered across the internet. This is where it all finally lives together.

about.title: A cosy corner for the grown-ups
about.intro: This is the space for the trust, the details and the small print, so the little ones can just enjoy the songs and stories. Loulou & Lou started in the Netherlands and today travels far beyond our own front door.
about.bandBody: On stage, every note is played live by our band of exceptionally talented musicians, the beating heart of every theatershow.
about.animatorBody: The Sprookjesfilm is animated entirely in-house, frame by frame, by our own animator.
about.safetyBody: No ads aimed at children, no data harvesting, and no purchase or external link a child can reach without a grown-up step first. Calm, worry-free design is a requirement here, not an afterthought.
about.comingTitle: More grown-up tools on the way
about.comingBody: Profiles, language settings, subscriptions and parental controls are next on our roadmap, right here in this corner of the app.
about.givingBackBody: We want to win children's hearts with a love of real music and imagination, and we put our money where our mouth is with projects like these.
about.contactBody: Booking a show, press enquiry, or just want to say hi? Get in touch.
